page: Microsoft Azure D48plds_v7 is an ARM-based virtual machine instance from the Dpldsv7 series, operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 48 dedicated vCPUs built on a 64-bit ARM architecture. With 96.0 GB of total system RAM, the instance maintains an allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, orienting the platform toward compute density rather than large memory footprints.

The instance includes 2832 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, delivering low-latency ephemeral scratch space for data-heavy operations alongside support for Premium Storage remote disks. There are no GPU accelerators present, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

By limiting RAM to 2.0 GB per core, this instance offers high qualitative cost efficiency for compute-centric workloads that do not require extensive memory capacity. It is suitable for parallel batch processing, continuous integration compile nodes, web application fleets, and distributed data processing tasks compiled for the arm64 architecture.
